what: One server pause point in POST /folder-access (setFolderAccess), asking the stack's gate service whether to go on after the folder's grants are read and the request's delta applied to them, and before they are written. For a deterministic lost update between concurrent folder grants: C16b folder grants S18 (N grants on one folder, held after every one has read the grants, then let go one at a time). Its own helper (functions/src/lib/e2eFolderAccessGate.ts), so it applies alone or beside the other amplify sets, amplify-c16-access included

gates.name: folder-access-before-write
gates.where: functions/src/lib/management.ts setAccess: after the folder is read, the caller authorized and the delta applied to the grants read, before ref.set writes them and recomputeSubtree runs
